references.text: Abraham's servant also provided straw and fodder for the camels, demonstrating hospitality and care for travelers and their animals.
Joseph arranged for fodder for his brothers' donkeys, a similar example of providing food for travelers and their animals.
Joseph's steward gave water to wash feet and fodder for the donkeys, illustrating Eastern hospitality.
The old man took in the Levite and provided fodder for the donkeys and food for the traveling party, a direct continuation of this conversation.
The Lord had blessed Israel so that they lacked nothing, similar to the expression 'I shall not want'.
David confesses that with the Lord as his shepherd he lacks nothing, using the same expression for contentment and the satisfaction of needs.
